prompts.title: The Cybernetic Oracle
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic futuristic humanoid portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. The composition is a centered, symmetrical head-and-upper torso shot with balanced negative space and no cropping of the head or shoulders. The subject’s eyes are closed, conveying a calm, meditative, and serene expression, with relaxed facial muscles and a perfectly neutral pose.
The subject has no outfit, with the upper body bare and cleanly visible (non-explicit), allowing full focus on the glowing bio-energy system across the skin.
The skin features hyper-detailed, glowing turquoise bio-energy lines flowing seamlessly across the face, neck, shoulders, and upper torso, designed like advanced neural circuits and energy veins. These luminous patterns should feel anatomically integrated and softly embedded beneath the skin, emitting a subtle, ethereal glow without overpowering natural skin texture. Maintain realistic pores and fine skin detail—no plastic or overly smooth finish.
Hair is sleek, voluminous, and naturally styled, with subtle teal rim highlights reflecting the glow of the energy lines. No exaggerated or artificial strands—keep it grounded in realism with controlled shine.
Background is a dark, futuristic sci-fi environment with a soft blur, featuring faint holographic UI elements, abstract data fragments, and distant city-like structures. Ensure the background remains defocused to keep full emphasis on the subject.
Lighting is cinematic and controlled: soft frontal key light for facial clarity, combined with cool cyan/turquoise rim lighting from both sides and behind to enhance the glowing circuitry. Add subtle volumetric haze and atmospheric diffusion to create depth and a holographic aura effect.
Overall mood is serene, advanced, and slightly surreal—blending human realism with futuristic augmentation. Style should feel like high-end cinematic photography mixed with expert Photoshop compositing (no CGI or cartoon rendering). Ultra-sharp focus, high dynamic range, 8K quality, detailed, moody, and atmospheric.
